answer: A payout is split so that 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The river schedule is applied in hollow and oasis exposes each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1281 identities would post 3974 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
